message: ${aws:PrincipalAccount} used in ARN account position (namespace) — IAM policy variable substitution is supported only in the relative-id (resource path), not in the account field. Causes MalformedPolicyException or silent no-match, rendering both boundary statements non-functional.

securityhub:ListEnabledProductsForImport is scoped to the 'hubv2' resource type but SAR reports this action only supports the 'hub' resource type. The hubv2 ARN will never match, making this permission ineffective.
